title: KB-GRAPH-1: add a kb_graph_query MCP tool wrapping neighbors/nodesByType with deterministic output
description:
From the 2026-07-18 intake+KB-graph design review (Q2, recommended path step 1). The internal graph (knowledge/graph/graph.json, src/knowledge-graph.js) is WRITE-ONLY: populated manually at ticket-close but never queried at decision time. Unlike the flat KB (kb_lookup MCP tool, src/mcp-server.js:275), the graph has NO MCP tool and no programmatic query surface for agents — 'graph lookup' today means a human/agent reading graph.json by hand.

Add a kb_graph_query MCP tool mirroring kb_lookup's deterministic/reproducible contract: input { id?, type?, relation?, direction? } -> deterministic result derived from neighbors()/nodesByType() (src/knowledge-graph.js), registered in src/mcp-server.js alongside kb_lookup. This is the foundation ticket for the KB-graph epic (KB-GRAPH-2/4 depend on it).
acceptance_criteria: A kb_graph_query MCP tool is registered in src/mcp-server.js with a documented input schema { id?, type?, relation?, direction? } and returns a deterministic, schema-shaped result derived from neighbors()/nodesByType() (src/knowledge-graph.js).
Given the same graph.json and same args, the output is byte-stable/reproducible so a reviewer can re-run the identical call — proven by spec.
Invalid or empty args are handled gracefully (documented typed error or empty result, not a server-crashing throw); a missing node id yields empty neighbors, not an exception.
dist/mcp-server.cjs (and any other bundle embedding it) rebuilt + committed; dist-parity green.
tdd: new tool contract + output-shape fixtures.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body:
SCOPE REFINEMENT (human decision 2026-07-18): build kb_graph_query on the MERGE SEAM, not the local-only neighbors(). Use src/graph-sync.js#neighborsCanonicalFirst (canonical-first, local-fallback) as the underlying read path so the SAME tool serves both modes:
- Brain ABSENT (the shipped default, zero infra): falls back to the local projection (knowledge-graph.js neighbors/nodesByType) — behavior identical to the original local-only scope.
- Brain PRESENT (opt-in /hivemind:brain): merges canonical-first, preferring the wisearcher graph, local as fallback.

AC amendments:
- The determinism/reproducibility AC applies to the NO-BRAIN (local) path — that is the reproducible contract a reviewer re-runs offline (inject brain=absent). Brain-present results depend on live brain state and are explicitly OUT of the deterministic lock's scope (document this).
- ADD: with no brain configured, kb_graph_query returns the local-graph result via the fallback path, proven by spec with the brain injected as absent (graph-sync.js is already injectable/unit-testable per its design).
- Keep nodesByType (type-only queries) on the local graph unless a clean canonical equivalent exists; neighbors/id queries go through neighborsCanonicalFirst. Developer: confirm the graph-sync surface covers the needed query shapes; if a shape has no canonical-first path yet, local-only for that shape is acceptable — note it.
Rationale: near-zero delta now (graph-sync.js + brain-client.js already exist and degrade gracefully), keeps local the default, and makes the query surface external/merge-ready without re-touching the tool later.
